summary: Iteration 4: tested the new snap flow (/something-broke/), the sample SF directory and the voice agent, backend and frontend. Backend: 18/18 pytest pass (directory for all 7 trades, ranking, lat/lng and far-origin fallback, auth 401, 422 validation, voice camera/general/bench, voice validation). Frontend: the 'Take a picture' button opens the live-camera dialog, and no form or selects appear before the photo. Upload goes to diagnose-thinking and then auto-filled results. The typed Tahoe hot-tub text gave 'Hot tub & spa' + 'Hot tub · Tahoe Cabin' + 'This week' (Friday is 5 days from the env date of Sun Oct 25, so this is reasonable), plus a diagnosis and a 5-step fix guide. The directory shows 4 ranked hot-tub pros: first has the Best match badge and starts expanded; toggle collapses and expands; details show 2 photos, 6 metrics, 4 reviews and tel:/maps links; Save changes to 'On your bench' and the Undo toast deletes the contractor (checked via the API); the Sample listings label is visible. 'Wrong? Change' shows 3 selects, and changing the trade refetches the directory. Track goes to /issue/?id=...; tracking again shows the existing-issue dialog, and 'Add to it' goes to the same issue. The voice launcher is on all (app) pages; text Q&A replies in about 3-5s; 'my toilet is cracked' goes to /something-broke/?camera=1 and the camera auto-opens. The mic button is present in Chromium. No horizontal overflow at 390px. Found 2 real bugs (a race on early upload, and an empty diagnosis when can_tell=false) plus minor ranking/API items.

minor.issue: An unknown trade silently falls back to Plumbing results, but the response still echoes trade:'Roofing'. Either return 400 or echo the trade actually used.

An unlicensed business can be #1 'Best match' (Plumbing: Twin Peaks Plumbing Co, licensed=false, score 62, beats licensed Fog City at 61). The licence penalty (-5 vs +3) is weak for a 'best' recommendation. Product call, but likely not what the user expects.

ui_bugs.issue: Race / stale closure: Capture is rendered while props are still null (`step === 'capture' || !props`). If the user uploads or snaps before /api/properties resolves, the `run` closure holds props=null, autoFill() throws inside the try, and the user sees 'Couldn't read that right now' even though /api/issues/diagnose returned 200. Reproduced by uploading right after page load; a 3s wait before upload works. More likely when arriving via voice ?camera=1, which auto-opens the camera immediately. Fix: render a loader until props load, or read props from a ref inside run().

When the AI returns can_tell=false but still gives a trade (e.g. /tmp/pipe.jpg returns can_tell:false, trade:Plumbing, diagnosis:null), the results page shows an empty 'What's wrong' (snap-diagnosis is blank) and no fix guide, with no notice. Show a notice such as 'We weren't sure, here's our best guess' or fall back to the retry state.

design_issues.screen: /something-broke/ with voice panel open on mobile
issues: On 390px the voice panel (max-h 70vh, bottom-24) covers most of the directory card actions. Acceptable since it can be closed, but consider a bottom-sheet with a smaller height.

action_items: Fix the props-null race in SnapFlow: show a loader until properties load, or use a ref so run()/autoFill never sees null props.
Handle can_tell=false with a trade: show a notice and/or fallback text instead of a blank 'What's wrong'.
Directory: return 400 (or echo the effective trade) for unknown trades; consider penalising unlicensed businesses more so they don't get 'Best match'.
critical_code_review_comments: DirectoryCard Undo sets saved=false even if the DELETE fails (the error is swallowed). Minor.
locate() can take up to 4s. If diagnose returns sooner, the directory is fetched without geo (geo.current is still null), and it is not refetched when the location arrives.
track(): when amenity_id is null, the existing-issue check is skipped entirely, which allows duplicate property-level issues.
Voice: history items are untyped dicts (List[dict]). Consider a Pydantic model with role/text enums.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 Tahoe hot-tub issue (deleted afterwards) and 1 SF contractor (removed via the Undo toast). Demo data otherwise untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test images are in /tmp: toilet.jpg is a clean bathroom (correctly gives 'can't tell'); pipe.jpg gives can_tell=false with trade Plumbing (shows the blank-diagnosis bug); hottub.jpg. To reproduce the race, set_input_files on snap-upload-input immediately after snap-take-picture-button appears. Wait ~3s first to avoid it. The voice agent answers with real open issues. '/' is the public landing page (no voice launcher, by design). Don't run next build.
